decisions.value: Review preview copies the revision currently rendered in the panel, not the live plan.
Expired preview keeps the copy control visible and active; it copies what is displayed and the existing expiry line carries the warning.
No title, no heading, no front matter: source text only.
Text selection inside the plan is ignored; the whole plan is always copied.
Each click inside the 1.2 s window writes again and restarts the confirmation window.

notes: D1, D3, D4 were fixed by the user's own plan; D2 was put to the user because the plan said no button on expired while the frame defaulted to keeping it — the user chose to keep it; D5 stands on its default.
